_comment: Despite the name, nothing here is order-wrapped or concatenated-wrapped: the modules inline flat with no init_*/__esm and no module group. It does NOT exercise the concatenated-wrapper (ConcatenateWrappedModuleKind Inner/Root) x order-wrap interaction, which is unsupported: only the deferred groups of `importDefer` use Inner/Root, and strict execution order turns them off (see internal-docs/import-defer/implementation.md). Thus it must not be counted as wrapper coverage.
